title: 回环句
summary: 句子由单空格分隔的单词组成；若每个单词末字符等于下一单词首字符，且最后单词末字符等于首单词首字符，则称为回环句。
insight: 无需真正切分单词。首尾字符负责闭环；每个空格两侧恰是相邻单词的末字符和首字符，只需检查这些边界。
pitfalls: 还要检查最后单词到第一个单词
句中只有一个单词时仍需首尾相等
输入保证单词间恰有一个空格

solutions.title: 扫描空格边界
solutions.idea: 直接在原字符串检查所有相邻单词接口。
steps: 若 sentence[0] != sentence[last] 返回 false
扫描每个空格下标 i
若 sentence[i-1] != sentence[i+1] 返回 false

code.java: class Solution { public boolean isCircularSentence(String sentence){if(sentence.charAt(0)!=sentence.charAt(sentence.length()-1))return false;for(int i=1;i+1<sentence.length();i++)if(sentence.charAt(i)==' '&&sentence.charAt(i-1)!=sentence.charAt(i+1))return false;return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun isCircularSentence(sentence:String):Boolean{if(sentence.first()!=sentence.last())return false;for(i in 1 until sentence.lastIndex)if(sentence[i]==' '&&sentence[i-1]!=sentence[i+1])return false;return true} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:bool isCircularSentence(string sentence){if(sentence.front()!=sentence.back())return false;for(int i=1;i+1<(int)sentence.size();++i)if(sentence[i]==' '&&sentence[i-1]!=sentence[i+1])return false;return true;} };
